_meta.description: D6 fixtures for google-antigravity / gen-ui-declarative (A2UI Dynamic Schema, declarative-gen-ui demo)
_meta._note: Backend-owned A2UI: the outer agent calls the generate_a2ui server tool with {request: <question>}; the tool makes its own forced render_a2ui generateContent call (X-AIMock-Context: google-antigravity, user text = the request), validates it and returns the a2ui_operations container the A2UI middleware paints. Inner legs are listed first and matched by toolName=render_a2ui.
_meta.googleAntigravityStaging: Staged on turnIndex, not hasToolResult/toolCallId: the Antigravity Go harness never sends role:"tool" messages (see PARITY_NOTES.md). turnIndex is the assistant-message count: +2 per tool round trip, +1 per text answer. Every pill carries outer legs at every position a four-pill thread can reach it from (0/2, 3/5, 6/8, 9/11), so the d5 probe (all four pills in one thread) and the e2e spec (one pill per fresh thread) both resolve.
